evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked what it was like when everyone was cheering him on: "It was incredible, Dave! The room was buzzing with energy and love. It was a powerful reminder of why I'm doing this." [S28T4][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, said creating something that people connect with and brings joy "is what I'm all about," and moments like the party "really motivate me to keep growing!" (complements his earlier "passion and purpose" remark of 2023-10-25, see above) [S28T7].
- On 2023-11-02, in the chat's closing music exchange, said "Wow Dave! Music really has a way of touching our souls." — that connection is what he's aiming for with his music (complements his long-stated belief that music is his "passion and purpose"/"fuels my soul," see above; studio details in ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) [S28T25][S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, the chat then moved on: Dave cheered Calvin on — "Wow, Calvin, that's awesome! Keep up the great work!" — and shared a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notepad on it; Calvin asked whether the notebook helps Dave stay connected to the creative process (Dave: it's for writing lyrics and notes — "writing lyrics boosts my motivation to grow") and asked what tunes Dave's been listening to lately (Dave: classic rock — "the music from that era is timeless") (conversation flow in the 2023-11-02 entry of ## Relationships; Dave's details in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S28T32][S28T33][S28T34][S28T39][S28T40].
- On 2023-11-02, closing the chat's music exchange: told Dave "Classic rock has had a huge effect on music" and encouraged him to "keep discovering!"; signed off saying "Exploring different styles and times can open up new perspectives. Broadening your musical knowledge is awesome" and wishing Dave good luck with work (conversation flow in the 2023-11-02 entry of ## Relationships; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S28T41][S28T43].

- As of 2023-08-11, has a music studio setup with a high-quality sound system; offered Calvin a hand with his music stuff ("if you need a hand with your music stuff, just let me know!") — "You won't believe how amazing your songs sound here!" — and shared a photo of the setup (a desk with a keyboard, monitor, and keyboard pad); Calvin thanked him but said he's "super busy with my music stuff at the moment" and will keep the offer in mind [S13T15][S13T16].
- Last weekend before 2023-09-15 (~2023-09-09/10), attended a rock concert in Boston — "take a look at what an amazing atmosphere it was!" — and shared a photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights [S19T1].
- On 2023-09-22, invited Calvin to jam some music together — "'California Love' is a classic! Let me know if you wanna jam some music together!" — and Calvin accepted; the two are now looking forward to an awesome jam session and creating something special (conversation flow in ## Relationships; Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S20T9][S20T10][S20T11][S20T16].
- Just before 2023-10-15, told Calvin he just got back from a music festival — "it was amazing! The energy, the music, the crowd - sooo good. I felt so alive!"; shared a photo from the event of the main stage (a photo of a stage with a crowd of people watching a band) — "The main stage was unreal. The headliner was so good and the vibe was unreal!"; Calvin asked for photos from the festival to "join in on the fun" and asked who the headliner was; Dave answered (late in the chat, [S23T9]): The Fireworks headlined the festival, and Calvin said he "heard great things" about them (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-15 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S23T5][S23T6][S23T7][S23T8][S23T9].
- On 2023-10-23, while praising the attention to detail in Calvin's music ("Loving the attention to detail in your work, it makes it extra special. Keep on creating!"), shared a photo of his amp (a brown amp with a black knob and a brown cover) (conversation flow in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; Calvin's record photo in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T23].

- Dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them; hopes his music can reach a global audience and make an impact [S3T9].
- On 2023-05-01, expressed that it's an amazing feeling when something you create resonates with people, and satisfying to finish something made from scratch — the same joy he finds in seeing a creation come to life [S4T10][S4T12].
- Has a home music studio where he "pour[s] [his] heart into the music"; shared a photo of it (keyboard, synthesizer, and other musical equipment) while telling Dave about the house flood [S6T5].
- On 2023-05-03, said he's stuck with his music — "like [his] creativity's frozen" — and asked Dave for tips; said he'll take Dave's advice (take a break from music and explore other things for fun) to get his "mojo" back, and affirmed he won't give up on his music [S5T10][S5T11][S5T12][S5T14].
- On 2023-05-16, "super excited" for the Tokyo performance happening this month (May 2023) — a chance to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand his following (details in ## Tokyo trip) [S6T11]. The tour went ahead: as of 2023-05-31 he had been touring with Frank Ocean the week before (see ## Tokyo trip) [S7T1].
- As of 2023-06-09, has an album in progress ("my album"); met with the creative team for it on 2023-06-08 — "a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together", and he's "feeling stoked" and "making some magic" in the studio working on the music and everything. He shared a photo of the studio (a recording studio with a large window and a desk) [S8T1][S8T3].

- On 2023-11-13, asked Calvin whether he finds having supportive people around him important for his artist development ("Do you also find having supportive people around you important for your artist development?"); Calvin: yes — they are key for him to grow as an artist, motivating him to get better and stay true to himself, and vital in the tough music industry (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S29T6][S29T7]. Then, shown Calvin's photo of a group of people sitting around a desk, Dave asked "Is this a pic of some musicians you're collaborating with?" — unanswered in this excerpt [S29T7][S29T8].
- On 2023-11-13, reacted to Calvin's news that he's been supporting young musicians from a music program: "Wow, Calvin, that's amazing! You're really making a difference by supporting the next generation of musicians. It's great to nurture their passion and help them thrive."; then, after Calvin said it's "like a torch being passed to keep music alive" and that he'll support the ambitious young musicians for a long time, Dave: "Your support for them keeps the music going and passes on the legacy. That's so awesome!" (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S29T9][S29T10][S29T11][S29T12]. Shown Calvin's photo of himself making a beat for a young artist, Dave: "Wow, that's cool! Your music studio looks great. Have you tried out any new ideas lately?" and, hearing Calvin is having fun trying out new sounds and pushing the boundaries ("always gotta stay ahead in this"), said "Awesome, Calvin! Experimenting and pushing boundaries is key to making our art grow. Can't wait to see where these new ideas take you!" (Calvin's details in the Recording studio section of /memories/calvin.md); Calvin: "Yeah, it's exciting to see where these new ideas lead. It's all about growing and evolving!" and signed off, "Have a good one. I need to go now. Take care, Dave!"; the chat closed with Dave: "For sure, Calvin! Growing and evolving is key for any artist. Don't stop pushing yourself and keep exploring. Can't wait to see what you come up with next! See ya Cal! Take care!" [S29T13][S29T14][S29T15][S29T16][S29T17][S29T18].
- On 2023-11-17, after Calvin told him he'd had an inspiring chat with "this cool artist" at the fancy gala he attended in Boston the day before (2023-11-16) — they clicked over music and art and talked about how the power of music connects people (Calvin's side in the Music and Boston trip sections of /memories/calvin.md; conversation flow in ## Relationships): "That's amazing, Calvin! Music really does bring people together and foster creativity. Glad to hear you had such an inspiring conversation!" [S30T5].
- On 2023-11-17 (later in the same chat, in the closing exchange after Calvin shared his Japanese-garden photo), Calvin announced he has a few more great news: he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston — "It's going to be an unforgettable musical experience!" — and he'll fill Dave in on all the details later (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing news! Congratulations on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance. I can't wait to hear all about it and maybe even catch one of your shows in Boston. Let me know when you're free to catch up. Cheers to your musical journey!"; Calvin: "Thanks, Dave! I'll catch you when I'm in Boston. Cheers!" — and the chat closed with goodbyes (Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you. Stay safe, talk to you soon!"; Calvin: "Thanks! You too. Talk to you later!") [S30T20][S30T21][S30T22][S30T23][S30T24].

- On 2023-07-21, told Dave he is working on a project to transform his Japanese mansion into a recording studio — it has been his dream to have a space for creating music with other artists, and the studio is "my sanctuary that reminds [him] why [he] loves music" (home is the mansion from ## New home (2023-03-23); earlier studio photos are under ## Music); shared a photo of the progress so far (a room with a ladder in it) [S11T4].
- Has been experimenting with different genres lately, pushing himself out of his comfort zone — adding electronic elements to his songs gives them "a fresh vibe"; he calls it "an exciting process of self-discovery and growth" [S11T6].
- Finds switching between styles challenging — "it's a matter of finding the right balance between sticking to [his] sound and trying new stuff"; "it can be intimidating, but that's what makes it so exciting and keeps [him] motivated to keep going!" [S11T8].
- On 2023-11-02, said the connection music creates with people is "that connection I'm aiming for with my music" (his goal for his music; complements his 2023-10-25 "passion and purpose" remark — see ## Music) [S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, shared a photo of the studio setup (a recording studio with a monitor, keyboard, and monitor) — Calvin: "Take a loot at my studio setup, that's look awesome, isn't it?"; Dave: "Wow, your studio looks stunning!" [S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked how he likes hanging out there and whether he watches much TV: he only works in the studio; he has a separate room for relaxation with a TV (photo of a living room with a couch, chair, television and a table — "that room is cozy and relaxing"), which is "a great way to unwind and get inspired" [S28T29].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked what he usually watches on it: he usually watches music videos, concerts, and documentaries about artists and their creative process — "It's cool to learn more about the industry and see what others do." — and it's "a source of inspiration for me" [S28T31].
- On 2023-11-13, when Dave asked whether he's tried out any new ideas lately: he's having fun trying out new sounds and pushing the boundaries — he likes going for new ideas and seeing where they take him, because "always gotta stay ahead in this" (a continuation of his 2023-07-21 experimenting-with-genres thread above; Dave: "Experimenting and pushing boundaries is key to making our art grow") [S29T14][S29T15][S29T16].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-08-22, scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean — "a dream come true"; "I've been working hard and it's finally paying off", and "no words can describe how happy I am" [S15T2].
- How it came about: he met Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and they clicked; they've been speaking and sharing ideas, arranged a meeting, and Calvin recorded a song in the studio at his mansion (the mansion he is turning into a recording studio, see ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) — "it's been great!" [S15T4]. (This may be the Tokyo music festival he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20) — but that is not confirmed.)
- On that festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the festival crowd was "so lively" — "it was like fuel for my soul"; he called the experience "a dream come true" — "The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!"; shared a photo of the crowd (people sitting on the grass at night) [S15T6][S15T8].
- How it started — Calvin's account on 2023-10-19: "It all started August last year" (i.e., August 2022) when he and Frank Ocean met at a festival and Frank said he wanted to collaborate — "We clicked right away and the chemistry on stage was incredible. I'm so lucky!" This is a later, more specific account than the 2023-08-22 one (a Tokyo music festival, possibly the one he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)); the two accounts differ on when/where they met (August 2022 festival vs. a 2023 Tokyo festival) — both kept. [S24T5]
